# Milestone 2 — Yaku Dex (plan, 2026-09-23)

## Context

School requirement: a public REST API. The yaku catalog is hosted on GitHub
Pages (`https://code-nam.github.io/tenpai-api/yaku/v1/catalog.json`, 20 yakus,
`application/json`), the base URL is injected with
`--dart-define=YAKU_BASE_URL` (already in `.vscode/launch.json` and README).
Handoff screen 13 (« Yaku Dex »): title, subtitle, search field, four tier
chips, one card per yaku (romaji name 18/600, French nickname in mono, 4–5
mini tiles, « n han » badge, one short line); locked yakus dimmed with a lock
and face-down tiles. No detail screen in the handoff, so none in M2.

Decisions taken during brainstorming (user):
- Unlock = per-yaku `unlockUnit` (unit id) in the catalog; unlocked once that
  unit is fully completed in `userProgressProvider`; `null` = always unlocked.
- Card text = new one-line `summary` field; `description` stays for later.
- `dioProvider` lives in `lib/yaku/yaku_providers.dart` (only consumer).
- `Yaku` model lives in `lib/yaku/yaku.dart` (feature-local).

Working mode unchanged: user writes `lib/`, Claude tutors and reviews;
Claude owns the catalog repo edits, `test/` via test-writer, docs. Isar cache
of the catalog is M4+, not here. No new dependencies (`dio` already in
pubspec).

## Layout (all new files under the user's flat feature folder)

```
lib/app/app_config.dart            AppConfig.yakuBaseUrl (String.fromEnvironment)
lib/yaku/yaku.dart                 Yaku (freezed) + YakuTier enum
lib/yaku/yaku_remote_source.dart   YakuRemoteSource(Dio): GET yaku/v1/catalog.json
lib/yaku/yaku_repository.dart      abstract interface YakuRepository { catalog() }
lib/yaku/yaku_repository_impl.dart caches the Future, drops it on failure
lib/yaku/yaku_providers.dart       dioProvider, yakuRepositoryProvider,
                                   yakuCatalogProvider, yakuQueryProvider,
                                   yakuTierFilterProvider, yakuCardsProvider
lib/yaku/yaku_screen.dart          replaces the placeholder
```

Mirrors `lib/learning/` (`LessonRepository` → `LessonAssetSource` →
`LessonRepositoryImpl` → `lesson_providers.dart`), so every step has a
worked example next to it.

## Data

Catalog entry gains two fields (Claude, `tenpai-api` repo, still `v1`:
additive):
- `summary`: one line for the card (≤ 70 chars, French).
- `unlockUnit`: `"unit_01"` … `"unit_06"` or `null`. Essentials → `null` or
  `unit_01`; common → `unit_02`/`unit_03`; rare → `unit_04`+.

`Yaku` (freezed, `fromJson`): `id, name, kanji, nickname, summary,
description, han, hanOpen (int?), tier (YakuTier), tiles (List<String>),
unlockUnit (String?)`. `YakuTier { essential, common, rare }` with
`@JsonValue`. Unknown tier → parse error, surfaced as the retry state.

## Data flow

```
dioProvider ─▶ YakuRemoteSource.fetchYakus() : Future<List<Map>>   (unwraps "yakus")
            ─▶ YakuRepositoryImpl.catalog()  : Future<List<Yaku>>  (Yaku.fromJson, cached)
            ─▶ yakuCatalogProvider           : FutureProvider<List<Yaku>>
yakuQueryProvider  : NotifierProvider<_, String>      (search text)
yakuTierFilterProvider : NotifierProvider<_, YakuTier?> (null = « Tous »)
unitsProvider + userProgressProvider (existing)
            ─▶ yakuCardsProvider : Provider<AsyncValue<List<(Yaku, bool unlocked)>>>
                 filter by tier, then by query over name/nickname/kanji
                 (case- and accent-insensitive), unlocked = unlockUnit == null
                 || every lesson of that unit completed
```

Screen watches `yakuCardsProvider` only; taps write to the two notifiers.

## Error / loading

- `AsyncError` (DioException of any type, or parse error) → `RetryWidget`
  (« Impossible de charger les yakus »), `onRetry` invalidates
  `yakuCatalogProvider`. Offline is the `connectionError` case, same UI.
- Loading: header, search and chips render immediately; the list area stays
  empty. No spinner (handoff). Decision to log in ROADMAP.
- `AppConfig.yakuBaseUrl` empty → `assert` in `main()` fails fast in debug.
- Repository drops a failed cached Future (lesson M1 review lesson).
